attributes.board_name: North Carolina Board of Licensed Clinical Mental Health Counselors

rules.accepted_credit_types: Providers approved by or affiliated with ACA, AASCB, NBCC or CRCC (unlimited); AACC, AAMFT, APA, EACC, IAEAPE, National AHEC, NAADAC, NAPCP, NASW, National Rehabilitation Association: max 15 contact hours per renewal; academic credit (1 semester hour = 15 contact hours)
rules.new_licensee_rule: New licenses whose initial renewal period is less than two full years need 30 contact hours; period runs from date of issue to the second June 30.
rules.audit_note: Random audit of a percentage of licensees (Rule .0603(f)); keep CE documentation 7 years.

topics.who: All licensees (ACA or ACS Code of Ethics)
All licensees: no-fail Jurisprudence Exam after January 1 of the renewal year; counts as 5 contact hours of ethics
LCMHC Supervisors (LCMHCS); included in the 40 hours

rules.notes: CE must be earned July 1 – second June 30; renewal due by June 30 of the renewal year ($75 late fee). Publication, leadership, dissertation max 10 h each; presenting max 5 h. No home-study limit stated.
